description: This Swift source file defines the GatewayProcessManager class, which manages the lifecycle and state of a gateway process within the application. It handles starting, stopping, attaching to existing gateways, monitoring environment status, and logging. It also contains logic for managing launch daemons and connection health checks.

classes.name: GatewayProcessManager
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing the lifecycle, status, and communication with the gateway process within the application. Handles starting, stopping, environment refresh, log retrieval, and connection health checks.

classes.name: GatewayProcessManager.Status
classes.description: An enumeration representing the current status of the gateway process, including states like stopped, starting, running, attachedExisting, and failed.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the desired active state (start or stop) of the gateway process, triggering environment refresh and process management accordingly.

methods.name: ensureLaunchAgentEnabledIfNeeded
methods.description: Asynchronously ensures the launch agent for the gateway is enabled, auto-enabling it if necessary.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Starts the gateway process if it is desired and not already running or starting, attempting to attach to an existing instance first.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the gateway process, disables related launch agents, and resets relevant state.

methods.name: clearLastFailure
methods.description: Clears the last failure reason message.

methods.name: refreshEnvironmentStatus
methods.description: Refreshes the environment status, optionally forcing an update, with throttling based on minimum interval.

methods.name: attachExistingGatewayIfAvailable
methods.description: Attempts to connect to an already running gateway on the expected port to avoid starting a new process.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Provides a textual description of a port guardian instance or gateway details, including health status and linkage info.

methods.name: describe(instance:)
methods.description: Returns a string describing a port guardian instance.

methods.name: describeAttachFailure
methods.description: Generates a descriptive message for a failure to attach to an existing gateway, based on the error encountered.

methods.name: isGatewayAuthFailure
methods.description: Determines whether an error indicates an authentication failure with the gateway.

methods.name: enableLaunchdGateway
methods.description: Enables the launchd agent for the gateway and waits for the gateway to become available.

methods.name: appendLog
methods.description: Appends a string to the in-memory log buffer, trimming to limit size.

methods.name: refreshControlChannelIfNeeded
methods.description: Refreshes the control channel if it isn't already connected, with optional reason logging.

methods.name: waitForGatewayReady
methods.description: Asynchronously waits until the gateway is ready or timeout occurs.

methods.name: clearLog
methods.description: Clears the in-memory log and deletes the log file.

methods.name: setProjectRoot
methods.description: Sets the project root path in CommandResolver.

methods.name: projectRootPath
methods.description: Returns the current project root path from CommandResolver.
